messages:
Maya R.: FYI nightly eval just flagged a big uptick in exact repetition on synthQA (repeat-rate jumped from ~0.7% to 6.3% overnight). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/evals/19005/synthQA :eyes:
Liam C.: yikes. did the canary roll or a dependency bump land last night?
Maya R.: Canary for rwd-slim-6b q5_k went to canary-2 at 02:10 UTC. Rollout note: applied detokenizer patch (text-detok v1.2.4) + compiler kernel update (kern-ml v3.9).
Andre P.: I pulled a few failing examples — they're mostly long-form Q->A where the model repeats the last sentence verbatim 3-6x. looks like: "Answer: ... Answer: ... Answer:" repeated.
Sophie K.: logging from the reproducer shows repeated token IDs in the final buffer: `... 1278 1278 1278 1278` — detok might be merging subwords wrong after quant path.
Liam C.: can we repro locally on canary snapshot? which build id?
Maya R.: canary snapshot = rwd-slim-6b-q5k-canary-20260319-0210 (SHA: a7f3c). repro command I used: ```python repro.py --model rwd-slim-6b-q5k --prompts synthQA/fail-ids.txt --max-tokens 256 --stream=false```
CI Bot: nightly-eval/1900512345 completed: synthQA repeat_rate: 6.34% (+5.6% vs baseline), severity: high, created_issue: #ML-2317
Andre P.: quick check: when I run same snapshot but force detok v1.2.3 (previous), repeat rate drops to 0.9% locally.
Sophie K.: good signal. could also be interaction with kernel update; detok + kernel together caused a codepath misencode. we should isolate.
Liam C.: plan: 1) reproduce on canary infra with both detok v1.2.3 and v1.2.4 2) swap kernel back to kern-ml v3.8 3) add a failing-case unit test to nightly eval (fail-ids) 4) hold rollout if repro is confirmed.
Maya R.: I'll run (1) and (2) now on canary GPU pool A. tagging @Sophie K. for unit test.
Sophie K.: adding unit test to eval harness now. test will assert repeat_rate < 1% on synthQA sample batch. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/eval-harness/pull/482
Andre P.: logs from canary run 0216 (detok v1.2.4 + kern-ml v3.9): attached head excerpt: ```[out] tokens: ... 1278 1278 1278 1278
[detok] postmerge: inserted_marker=true duplicate_merge=true
[model] output_len=204 repeat_segments=3```
Liam C.: try forcing de-dup at detok layer as a hotfix (strip consecutive identical ids >2) and rerun to see delta. not ideal but could prevent regression in prod.
Maya R.: hotfix applied on canary (detok-hotpatch) — rerun synthQA sample: repeat_rate -> 0.95%. hotpatch halved error on bigger sample.
Sophie K.: hotpatch looks promising. I'll keep the unit test and add regression tracking to the perf dashboard. also opening rollback plan for canary-2.
Andre P.: root cause hypothesis: detok v1.2.4 introduced a post-merge optimization that incorrectly treats certain merged subword markers as repeatable spans when combined with new kernel token ordering. sequence boundary mask bug.
Liam C.: next steps: 1) revert detok to v1.2.3 in canary and run full nightly 2) write e2e test for merged-subword edge-case 3) coordinate rollback if full-nightly exceeds threshold 4) schedule postmortem and assign owners.
Maya R.: assigning: Andre -> lead root-cause + patch, Sophie -> eval harness test + dashboard, Liam -> rollout/rollback coordination, Maya -> PR review / customer comm.
CI Bot: issue #ML-2317 updated: status=investigating, severity=high, assignees=[Andre P., Sophie K., Liam C., Maya R.].
Sophie K.: small note — alert rule updated to fire at repeat_rate > 1.5% for synthQA until we stabilize.
Maya R.: thanks team. I'll post a short note to #eng-releases and #customer-success about holding the q5_k canary. :white_check_mark:
Liam C.: if anyone finds a smaller reproducer (single prompt) ping here and paste exact token trace. that will speed the patch.
Andre P.: will do. first reproducer looks like a "Why is X" long question with clarifying followups; i'll upload to the issue in 30m.
Maya R.: closing loop here once full nightly rerun is green. keep updates in thread. :railway_track:
